title: USDC depeg during March 2023 banking crisis
description: USDC traded below its USD peg during the March 2023 banking crisis after Circle disclosed that part of USDC reserves was held at Silicon Valley Bank. SOG records this as a recovered major depeg event, not as failed status.
notes: Deepened in PR-018A and PR-024A with Circle transparency, SVB exposure, product, reopening-operation, reserve-report, redemption-access, and deployment documentation sources. Lowest observed price and exact duration remain source-specific and should not be displayed until a market data source is selected.

title: TerraUSD collapse
description: UST lost its USD peg in May 2022 during a reflexive Terra/LUNA crisis and did not recover as a functioning stablecoin. SOG treats this as a collapse event supporting failed status, while post-collapse USTC trading is treated as lifecycle history rather than restored peg status.
notes: Deepened in PR-018B with SEC regulatory context and research sources for failure mechanics and post-collapse lifecycle. Exact intraday timeline, lowest observed price, LFG reserve intervention details, and USTC lifecycle require further source-specific review.

title: Paxos announces BUSD minting halt and wind-down
description: Paxos announced it would stop issuing new BUSD and end its relationship with Binance for BUSD while continuing redemption support during the wind-down period. SOG treats BUSD as discontinued through issuer wind-down, not as failed due to a depeg collapse.
notes: Deepened in PR-018C with Paxos wind-down, NYDFS-related context, reported SEC no-action outcome context, and exchange support phase-out context. Final redemption and exchange conversion status still require source-specific review.
